one_liner: API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale

evidence.claim: API uses an API key sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header
evidence.quote: For authentication, it’s required to include an Authorization header. The header should contain `Bearer fc-123456789`, where `fc-123456789` represents your API Key.

evidence.claim: Free tier with monthly credits gives self-serve API access
evidence.quote: Firecrawl is free for 1,000 pages every month (1,000 free credits per month).

evidence.claim: Developers can sign up and obtain an API key self-serve
evidence.quote: Sign up at firecrawl.dev to get your API key.

evidence.claim: REST API with programmatic access and many documented endpoints (search, scrape, crawl, map, parse, interact, monitor, account)
evidence.quote: The Firecrawl API gives you programmatic access to web data. All endpoints share a common base URL, authentication scheme, and response format described on this

evidence.claim: Vendor ships an official MCP server under its own GitHub org
evidence.quote: Adds powerful web scraping and search to Cursor, Claude and any other LLM clients.

notes: Keyless/rate-limited access exists for first scrape and MCP ('No account or API key is required for this request'; MCP 'work without an API key (rate-limited)'). Official MCP documented at docs.firecrawl.dev/mcp-server. Open-source self-host option. v2 API with ~40+ visible endpoints across scrape/crawl/search/interact/monitor/account; SDKs for Python, Node, CLI, plus more. Rate/concurrency limits vary per plan (429 responses).
